details: Developed Deep RL models (DDPG, TD3, SAC) for supply chain optimization using PyTorch and Ray RlLib.
Achieved 34.5% higher returns compared to industry standard baselines.
Developed web-app to track alt. financial data with configurable alerts, eliminating manual workflows.

careerEvents.position: Visiting Scholar, Research Fellow under Dr. Adish Singla
careerEvents.org: Max Planck Institute for Software Systems
details: Replicated results from paper (arxiv:2207.14722), optimizing implementation to compute higher order gradients.
Iterated and improved training times from 72hrs+ to 3hrs.
Linked unpredictable customer performance issues to memory bandwidth saturation via systematic workload analysis.
Reproduced intermittent latency issues using stress tests simulating customer I/O workloads from storage and network.
Built a pipeline & dashboard, to track & analyze, internal compute & storage cluster's usage metrics.
Pioneered effort to evaluate, benchmark and setup an internal data warehouse (ClickHouse).
Built the fault-tolerance story from ground up for the new native analytical query engine.
Impemented locality-aware adaptive shuffle data partitioning and coalescing for shuffle and broadcast operators
Reduced concurrent configuration GET/PUT perf by optimizing the data structures (multi-versioned, zero-copy).
Working on cardinality and cost-estimation for an experimental query optimizer.
